name: smwmusic-forsaken-underwater-city
title: Forsaken Underwater City
description:
A very sad theme, of an underwater city that was lost into darkness.
A small warning that this song may break in some parts if you keep pausing the game, due to it using very long notes, so, unless you're using AMK 1.0.8. and beyond, or KevinM's patch that fixes this problem, be careful.
